restaurant_name: Mabprachan Dental Clinic (มาบประชัน เด็นทัล คลินิกทันตกรรม)
text: A very good dentist. We took our 3 year old here and it was her first time so she was quite scared. The dentist was very kind, showed her exactly what he was doing, communicated with her every step of the way. They even put on Peppa Pig for her to watch whilst she was having some cavities fixed. I would highly recommend and will return again.

text: My second visit, the first was for a clean and check-up. I was told that I had a cavity that needed filling. Fast forward a few months, and I started to get pain in the area I was told to get filled, so I visited the practice to book an appointment. I was able to get a filling there and then, which I was pleased with. Very pleasant service and affordable. The dentist speaks English.
